title: POS cashier role and session hardening

checks.name: schema_has_pos_session_model
checks.details: Schema should persist POS sessions, cash closeout values, and sale linkage.

checks.name: migration_creates_pos_sessions
checks.details: Migration should add POS session table, indexes, and sale relation.

checks.name: cashier_role_is_minimum_but_session_ready
checks.details: Cashier should be able to sell, print, and manage own POS sessions without broader admin/finance/inventory powers.

checks.name: session_open_route_is_guarded_and_audited
checks.details: Opening a session should require session permission, block duplicate open sessions, and audit the action.

checks.name: session_close_route_calculates_cash_variance
checks.details: Closing a session should be own-session scoped and calculate expected cash and variance.

checks.name: pos_sales_attach_to_open_session
checks.details: POS sales should link to the cashier's open session when one exists.

checks.name: summary_includes_active_session_and_daily_cash
checks.details: POS summary should expose current session and daily cash closeout values.

checks.name: dashboard_exposes_session_controls
checks.details: Dashboard should show session status and open/close controls for permitted cashiers.

checks.name: session_styles_present
checks.details: Session panel should have stable dashboard styling.

checks.name: package_exposes_hal146_verifier
checks.details: HAL-146 verification must be runnable from npm scripts.
